$schema.description: Editor metadata URL for this configuration schema. Sift does not enforce this value at runtime.

history.description: Controls run history storage, retention, and secret redaction.

enabled.description: Record tool runs to the configured history path by default.

path.description: Directory used to store history files. Relative paths resolve from the config file directory.

max_files.description: Maximum number of stored history run files to keep.

max_age_days.description: Maximum age, in days, for stored history runs. Omit this field to disable age-based retention.

max_bytes_per_run.description: Maximum serialized payload size kept for each history run.

redact_secrets.description: Redact likely secrets from history payloads before writing them to disk.

output.description: Controls terminal and JSON output verbosity.

format.description: Default output format. Use `json` for normalized machine-readable output; `--json` also enables JSON for one command.

size.description: Default output detail level for tool results.

pretty.description: Pretty-print JSON output when JSON mode is enabled.

show_process.description: Show underlying process command/status details in terminal output.

tools.description: Per-tool settings. Use `*` for defaults inherited by every tool, and tool names such as `phpstan` for overrides.

*.description: Default settings inherited by every tool unless overridden by a specific tool entry.

timeout.description: Default process timeout in seconds. Use 0 to disable the timeout.

binary.description: Executable path or command used to run this tool. Relative paths resolve from the config file directory.

timeout.description: Process timeout in seconds for this tool. Use 0 to disable the timeout.

blocked_args.description: Command-line arguments that Sift must reject for this tool.
